blends.name: Propagator Container
blends.desc:
**Key Features:**

Nurture Level Usage: The "Propagator" container is specifically designed to be used at the "Nurture" level of the game. It aligns with the nurturing and growth aspects of your in-game journey.

Single Life: Each "Propagator" container has a single life, making it a valuable and finite resource within the game. This adds an element of strategy to your gameplay, as you'll need to decide when and where to utilize it.

Recycling Option: Once you've exhausted the life of your "Propagator Container," don't worry – it's not the end of its usefulness. You can recycle this NFT at the "Recycle Center" to obtain a new game item. This sustainable approach ensures that your gaming experience remains dynamic and engaging.

blends.name: 50% Nurture Boost
blends.desc:
**Nurture Boost:**
* Nurture boost can apply to any container. It will reduce the Nurture time as per Boost capabilities.
* The player can only use a Nurture boost to start the Nurture process.
* Nurture Boost NFTs have different capabilities 10%, 25% and 50%
* 10% and 25% Nurture Boost NFTs have multiple lifes


**Harvest Boost :**
* Harvest boost can apply to any Harvest. It will reduce the Harvest time as per Boost capabilities.
* The player can only use a Harvest boost at the start of the harvest (at the available state)
* Applied harvest boost will give benefits to all remaining harvest cycles.
* Harvest Boost NFTs have different capabilities 10%, 25% and 50%
* 10% and 25% Harvest Boost NFTs have multiple lifes

![](https://projectseedball.io/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/boost-banner-blending-page.jpg)
